2024
Author: Manoj Kumar Garg

[2024:RJ-JD:16484]
 HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 4402/2024 Banshilal S/o Babhutram, Aged About 30 Years, R/o Ravar Ki Dhani, P.s. Bilara, Dist. Jodhpur Raj.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
(Lodged In Central Jail Jodhpur)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through Pp  ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Bhagirath Ray Bishnoi For Respondent(s) : Mr. SS Rajpurohit,
PP  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 16/04/2024

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.296/2017 of Police Station Bilara, District Jodhpur for the offence punishable under Sections 313, 342, 370, 370-A(2),
376(2)(H)(N), 120-B of IPC and 3(1)(W-ii), 3(2)(v), 3(2)(v-a) of SC/ST Act.
He has preferred this bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Counsel for the petitioner submits that after thorough investigation, police did not file challan against the accused- petitioner.
Later on the trial court took cognizance against the accused-petitioner and issued arrest warrant against him.
In pursuance of the arrest warrant, the accused-petitioner was arrested and now he is in judicial custody.
Counsel for the petitioner further submits that the similar situated co-accused persons namely Hanuman Ram, Bhabhut Ram and Jija Bai have already been released on bail by this Court.

The case of the [2024:RJ-JD:16484] (2 of 2)
[CRLMB-4402/2024] present accused-petitioner is similar to those of the co-accused.
The trial of the case will take sufficient long time to be concluded.
Therefore, the benefit of bail should be granted to the accused- petitioner.
Learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I deem it Banshilal vs State Of Rajasthan (2024:Rj-Jd:16484) on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/174163290/
1 just and proper to grant bail to the accused petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the bail application filed under Sec.439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is directed that petitioner Banshilal S/o Babhutram shall be released on bail in connection with FIR No.296/2017 of Police Station Bilara, District Jodhpur provided he executes a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sound and solvent sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of learned trial court for his appearance before that court on each and every date of hearing and whenever called upon to do so till the completion of the trial.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 207-GKaviya/-
